title: 心理学実験
subtitle: Psychological Experiments
keywords: Design of psychological experiments 2.Factorial design 3.Statistical analysis
educationalGoal: The purpose of psychological experiments is to find general principles of psychological behavior under strictly controlled conditions. The objectives of this course are to learn the methods of factorial design for psychological experiments, to acquire the basic knowledge necessary for statistical analysis of data, and to learn the methodological framework of psychology as a science.
advice: Psychological research carries the risk of misunderstanding psychological mechanisms because everyday experiences are influenced by many factors. To avoid this risk, psychologists have developed their own scientific methodology for designing experiments with strict control of factors. This course prepares students to design their own experiments and provides basic knowledge of factorial design and statistical analysis of data.
requiredKnowledge: This course focuses on factorial design and statistical analysis of psychological methods. Students are required to learn the relationships between the courses of "psychological statistics" and "psychological methods".

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand factorial design and decide which experimental design is appropriate for each study.
Ability to run statistical analyses with appropriate methods.
Ability to read and understand articles applying a psychological experiment method.
Ability to understand the research methods in the important articles and apply them into your own study.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
